child_timestamp: Pre-fault a private native-endian two-i64 page on tmpfs before the child starts; set nonzero start, absolute nanosleep, store end via volatile memory, call _exit immediately. No userspace flush, write, close or stdio follows the end observation.

first_calibration.terminal: one 7.825070 ms child timestamp→wait return; all other gates held. Physical before timestamp included child printf to a newly created ext4 file. First exit 1 stays excluded from product clocks.

requirements: On a 6ms grid spanning 109 to 163ms: each blocking median within 3.5ms of requested, each adjacent median increment 3–9ms, kernel-reported child-end to blocking return p95 below 2ms and max below 6ms. Repeat pairs use 3 trials/duration and one extra untimed strace certification of wait4(..., 0) without WNOHANG. The polling stopwatch remains a measured comparator, never a substitute.
